copied_details.en: %s bytes → %s Base64 characters, copied to clipboard
copied_details.zh-Hans: 原始 %s 字节 → Base64 %s 字符，已写入剪贴板

saved_summary.zh-Hans: 已转换 %s 个文件为 Base64

action.script:
set -e
count=${NOTCH_COUNT:-1}
if [ "$count" -le 1 ]; then
  f="$NOTCH_FILE"
  [ -f "$f" ] || { echo "no input file" >&2; exit 1; }
  base64 < "$f" | tr -d '\n' | pbcopy
  size=$(stat -f%z "$f")
  chars=$(( (size + 2) / 3 * 4 ))
  notch_result --summary "$(printf "$(notch_t copied_summary)" "$(basename "$f")")" --details "$(printf "$(notch_t copied_details)" "$size" "$chars")"
else
  outdir="$NOTCH_OUTPUT_DIR"
  [ -n "$outdir" ] || outdir="$NOTCH_DIR"
  outs=()
  while IFS= read -r f; do
    [ -f "$f" ] || continue
    o="$outdir/$(basename "$f").b64.txt"
    base64 < "$f" | tr -d '\n' > "$o"
    outs+=("$o")
  done <<< "$NOTCH_FILES"
  [ "${#outs[@]}" -gt 0 ] || { echo "no valid input" >&2; exit 1; }
  args=(--summary "$(printf "$(notch_t saved_summary)" "${#outs[@]}")" --details "${outs[*]}")
  for o in "${outs[@]}"; do args+=(--output "$o"); done
  notch_result "${args[@]}"
fi
